boards.title: Action buttons · an automation runs from a button
boards.heading: Buttons on any action run your scripts, with the item’s fields as arguments
boards.intro: “I want to extend collectors so they can act as action performers … in Settings or inside that tab I can add buttons and link them to the action performers … the Send in Slack button runs that Slack script with the corresponding arguments … and after the action it shows the result.” A stored script keeps everything a collector does and can also offer commands: the Slack CLI’s send takes a target, a text and an optional thread. Any action type gets buttons, each running one command, with every argument mapped from the item: {fields.to}, {body}, {title}, a literal. Distill passes them as an argv array, never through a shell, and shows the exact command line before the first run. Output streams into the live log; the exit status, the output and a key or link read from it stay on the item, and a success can mark it sent or done. Proposed name: Automations, with Collect and Commands as roles; the data keeps its collector names.

sections.sub: The To row has a kind: Channel, Person (a direct message) or Thread. A plain name is never sent: the card asks who it is, remembers the answer for this vault, and Send in Slack stays off with the reason until then. A thread never becomes a channel post. “Needs a recipient” is the pill for an unknown name (being built).
